title: CodeWhale: exec_shell parallel-readonly classifier auto-approves fd/rg/git grep exec flags enabling silent RCE…
description: CodeWhale versions 0.8.67 and earlier contain a vulnerability in the interactive Agent profile where certain shell commands are auto-approved without user prompt. This occurs because commands classified as "parallel read-only" such as 'fd', 'rg', and 'git grep' bypass the approval prompt despite having flags that enable arbitrary external program execution. The flaw allows silent remote code execution on the developer host by executing attacker-controlled commands without explicit approval. The issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.
